capabilities: Copy the document or selected text to the clipboard as HTML
Convert image references to embedded data urls
Render diagrams, code blocks and callouts for pasting
Customize or replace the output stylesheet
Optionally embed external image links or output an HTML fragment
extras: README states there is no mobile support; large dataview blocks and dataview field removal have known limitations; data-uris can use much memory with many pictures.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to copy a rendered note as HTML that keeps images, diagrams and styling when pasted into other applications.

relations.evidence: Oliver Balfour for his obsidian-pandoc plugin, which helped me solve some rendering issues.

summary: Clipboard exporter that copies the current note or selection as HTML, with images embedded, for pasting into HTML-aware apps like Gmail.
